A small Cloud Sync status. It shows only while Cloud Sync is on and never implies that everything is backed up. After a failed sync with nobody signed in, it offers sign-in.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="React">
    <KitStatus kit="react" />

    **Drop-in.** `<CloudSyncStatus />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, inside `<PolarisKeyProvider config={polarisKey}>`.

    **Styled part.** The same component given an `input`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("CloudSyncStatus", input)` returns the view: its state and the copy keys it shows.

    [React](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/react/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<CloudSyncStatus />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<CloudSyncStatus />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("CloudSyncStatus", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="CloudSyncStatus" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
